notes.title: VAUDEVILLE, THE FIRST AI-DRIVEN DETECTIVE GAME, LAUNCHED TODAY ON STEAM
notes.notes:
Vaudeville, the much-anticipated, AI-driven detective game, breaks onto the scene today, marking a new chapter in the realm of interactive gameplay. Developed by Bumblebee Studios, Vaudeville leverages the power of artificial intelligence to create an immersive gaming experience unlike any other.

Set in the vibrant city of Vaudeville, a bubbling hub of culture and entertainment, players assume the role of Detective Martini, tasked with solving a series of enigmatic murders. The game offers a unique gameplay experience, intertwining AI-generated dialogues with real-time interactions. For the first time in gaming history, players can converse with characters using natural language, either by typing or talking into the microphone. The dialogues evolve in real-time, making each gameplay experience unique.

[previewyoutube=0mx6PRb9NuA;full][/previewyoutube]

The game captures the essence of detective work through its stunning narrative structure and complex characters, each with its own secrets to unravel. Players are thrust into a world of mystery, intrigue, and suspense, where every decision can change the course of the investigation.

In celebration of the launch, Bumblebee Studios is offering an early bird discount of 35% for the first week. This offer provides a golden opportunity for curious players to delve into the heart of Vaudeville and uncover its mysteries.

Vaudeville is more than just a game - it's an evolution in storytelling, a leap forward in interactive entertainment. With its AI-powered dialogue system, it offers an unparalleled level of immersion and player engagement. Every playthrough is unique, with the AI generating different responses based on your actions and choices.

Join Detective Martini in the city of Vaudeville, where secrets lurk in every corner, and the truth is stranger than fiction. Your adventure starts today. Welcome to Vaudeville!

notes.title: Abeyance Nominated at GDWC
notes.notes:
[b]Abeyance[/b], the thrilling rogue-lite, sci-fi dungeon-crawler developed by Bumblebee Studios, an indie studio based in Stockholm, Sweden, has been nominated for a prestigious [b]Houdini Award[/b] at the Game Development World Championship ([b]GDWC[/b]).

The GDWC is a global open competition for game developers that aims to celebrate awesome games and the developers behind them. Its goal is to highlight new and rising talents and teams and work tirelessly to create new opportunities for success for our participants. Through its 10-year history, GDWC has had over 25,000 developers participate from 135 different countries and has given out over $500,000 worth of prizes and giveaways.

Abeyance has been nominated for a Houdini Award at GDWC for its innovative use of Houdini and procedural generation in creating an immersive and captivating gaming experience.
"We are honoured to be nominated for a Houdini Award at GDWC," said Simone Odoardi, the lead developer of Abeyance. "Our team has put in a lot of hard work to create a game that offers a unique experience. Being recognised by the GDWC is a testament to our dedication and passion for gaming."

Abeyance takes players on a journey through forsaken space stations, where they must fight their way through hordes of aliens and robots, salvage abandoned items, and survive as long as possible. With its innovative use of Houdini and procedural generation, the game offers endless possibilities and challenges, keeping players engaged for hours.

Winners of the GDWC Awards will be announced on April 22nd.

notes.title: Bumblebee Studios releases free demo for AI-powered Vaudeville
notes.notes:
Attention all gamers and mystery enthusiasts! We are thrilled to announce that our upcoming game, Vaudeville, will be participating in the [b]Steam Mystery Fest[/b] event!

As part of this exciting event, we are offering a [b]free demo [/b]of Vaudeville, which is now available for download on Steam. This demo will allow players to get a sneak peek of the game, which is set in the mysterious world of the 1920s.

[previewyoutube=4Sa653Ac9l4;full][/previewyoutube]

As a detective in Vaudeville, players will be tasked with solving a series of complex murders in a stunningly-realized 1910s-era theatre. The game's [b]AI-powered characters[/b] each have their distinct personalities, backgrounds, and secrets, which players must unravel through careful observation and questioning.

The full version of Vaudeville will be released later this year, but in the meantime, we invite you to try out the demo and experience the thrill of the mystery fest. We can't wait to see you in the world of Vaudeville!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285800/Vaudeville/

The funds will be used to finish the development of the game and bring it to market. For more information visit https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bumblebeestudios/vaudeville-an-ai-driven-whodunit

We have watched countless youtubers and streamers play Abeyance, and guess how many of them have managed to play the whole story? Well, very close to zero.

You have to plan your moves, build your arsenal, develop your skills, before you can aim for the big target. But it is possible, we know. notes.title: ROADMAP FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ABEYANCE
notes.notes:
Hello and thanks for your interest in [b]ABEYANCE[/b] (or even better, [u]for having bought the game[/u], if you have)! 
We are really proud to have been able to deliver this game to you.
We are a [b]very small studio[/b] and we have been [b]working really hard[/b] to bring the [b]best product[/b] to you, but we are [b]working even harder[/b] to make this game [b]awesome(r)[/b].

[b]ABEYANCE[/b] is a [b]living game[/b] and we plan to release regularly new content in the form of [b]updates[/b] and [b]DLCs[/b].
But [b]ABEYANCE[/b] is not only that, it is also a [b]living universe[/b] in which we plan to keep developing more adventures with different or returning characters, stories and [b]genres[/b] (RTS, RPG, action, sim, ...).
We actually have a [b]wiki[/b] in which we are collecting all the lore surrounding the game, which we will use for inspiration for DLCs and new games. You can find it here: https://abeyancewiki.bumblebee-studios.se/wiki

We hope that you have patience if things may be a little shaky at times in the beginning and that you continue to support us in this exciting adventure. Don't hesitate to contact us at info@bumblebee-studios.se if you have any inquiries or suggestions.

These are the goals for the next updates:

notes.title: Abeyance Alpha Demo is here
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=WT8ktRRa5JU;full][/previewyoutube]

We have released an [b]ALPHA DEMO[/b] whose purpose is to introduce you to the basic mechanics and look & feel of the game.
This build is not optimized for all the systems and you may (and probably will) encounter bugs while playing it. Also, many of the assets, sound effects, animations are temporary and will be replaced with more suitable ones in the final version.
The demo is limited to one randomly generated dungeon. The complete game will feature a story-driven character development, a variety of dungeons with different environments and a rich assortment of types of loot and mobs, together with a lot of improvements and optimizations to the current features.
[u]The release of ABEYANCE on PC is planned for the end of summer 2022.[/u]
We hope you will enjoy playing [b]ABEYANCE [/b]as much as we are enjoying developing it :)

Bumblebee Studios
